subject.title: Conversational agent lane wedges indefinitely: ingress events never reconcile (re-delivery storm on reconnect) + abort_embedded_run leaves owner lock unreleased (released=0)

question: Should the remaining scope be resolved by landing the bounded durable replay/dead-letter approach in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99365, or should maintainers require a different ack-time reconcile/operator-drain design first?
rationale: Current main fixes the stale owner lock but not the WhatsApp durable replay storm, and the remaining requested operator controls affect channel behavior and supported recovery UX.

options.title: Review linked bounded replay fix
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99365 as the fix candidate for the remaining bug and leave drain/ack tooling as a follow-up decision.

options.title: Split operator tooling first
options.body: Keep the bug fix and operator drain/ack command as separate issues so the replay fix can be reviewed without committing to a CLI recovery surface.

options.title: Require live WhatsApp proof first
options.body: Hold the remaining fix until maintainers see pending channel_ingress_events accumulating on a build that includes the run-lifecycle main fix.

recommendation.title: Review linked bounded replay fix
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99365 as the fix candidate for the remaining bug and leave drain/ack tooling as a follow-up decision.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged lifecycle stack and already narrowed the issue discussion to Bug 2 plus operator policy.
